ClientId Unique client id, assigned to the instance of the calling module. Parameters (in) DTCFormat Defines the output-format of the requested DTC values Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType Status of the operation to (re-)set a freeze frame record filter. E_OK: Filter is accepted E_NOT_OK: Wrong filter selected Description Sets a freeze frame record filter. Available via Dem.h
